final_synthesis_label: Tiered, Time-Sensitive Resolution Protocol with Front-of-House Co-Design
final_synthesis_description: All three stakeholders accepted the core synthesis while the Primary Decision Maker and Morgan Calloway pushed for refinements around execution specificity; the protocol validates the customer, equips the server with pre-briefed messaging, and engages the chef privately — treating front-of-house staff as co-designers rather than delivery instruments, with speed as a non-negotiable constraint.
remaining_disagreements: Degree of specificity needed in server briefing scripts versus trusting staff judgment in the moment
How firmly to define the time threshold before dissatisfaction 'hardens' and the protocol escalates
Whether chef engagement should be framed as consultation or notification, given authenticity concerns
